scientific_integrity: Explicit edge-path presentation proves simple connectivity over arbitrary finite fields; independent finite mod-two checks are corroborative, not an integral or infinite proof. Novelty remains subject to possible unindexed equivalents.
scientific_limitations: Applies to the two-skeleton of the rank-one-difference clique complex for finite fields and matrix dimensions at least two. No conclusion about higher-dimensional full flag complexes, equivariant homology modules, or high-dimensional persistence. No independent audit.
title: Triangle-filled bilinear-forms graphs are wedges of two-spheres
